hypothesis: For both fixed N15 learned models, complete cache and arbitrary-cardinality15 inputs, and both ready-index/column and full-board paths, occupied-pair validation preserves every integer conflict count and has median runtime at least20 times faster than dense all-cell-pair validation.
dense: Enumerate all225 choose2 cell pairs, materialize co-occupancy and matrix-vector count with int32 binary F, identical formula to H3ag.
optimized: Enumerate15 choose2 occupied-cell pairs and sum their literal F values as int64. At most105 conflicts, so both exact integer types are safe. No zero-only or probabilistic certificate.

input_paths.available_columns_or_indices: Complete caches begin with row-column arrays; arithmetic cell construction is charged to both. Arbitrary grids begin with sorted occupied indices. Dense path also charges reconstruction of full225-cell boards.
input_paths.full_board: Both begin with Boolean225-cell boards. Optimized path charges np.nonzero extraction and reshape inside each timed call; dense uses boards directly. No free representation conversion.

random_grid.law: For each state, uniformly sample15 of225 distinct cells without replacement using default_rng, then sort. No permutation restriction.
random_grid.structured: Append full first row, full first column and main diagonal, each having105 forbidden pairs.

correctness: Every integer count must match over every complete-cache and arbitrary-grid state in every timed pair. Independent scalar combinations reference for first128 states of each input set; explicit105-conflict structured checks. Save inputs/counts and all array/file hashes.

trials.order: Alternate dense/occupied first by parity of trial+family+dataset_index+path_index; no discarded full-size warmup or adaptive repetitions.
trials.statistic: Ratio of median dense wall time to median occupied wall time; pair order and all CPU/wall timings retained. Descriptive point runtime comparison, no confidence interval.

budget.enforcement: Single-thread NumPy; /proc process-tree monitor plus final self+children rusage. Stop at119.8 CPU or179.8wall to allow receipt shutdown. Final pass requires<=120CPU and<=180wall. No extension; partial study inconclusive.

scope: CPU-only certificate microbenchmark. No fitting, GPU reruns, new puzzle cohorts or edits to H3ag. H3ag10x failure and9/18-batch amortization remain distinct.
overheads: Gate includes input loading/generation, validation, all timed trials, checksums and serialization. Each solve call includes pair-index construction, input representation conversion when needed, count computation and returned count array. Input disk loading/generation, inter-trial correctness checks/checksums and receipt serialization are outside solve-call times but included in total gate cost.
